nodes.title: SG-8 Suggest What Happens Next contribution modal
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet is a plain div dialog with a bare textarea, a Send button and a best-effort own-suggestions list, opened from a button in App. Desired behavior: a Radix modal opens from the gameplay screen without navigation, with a prompt textarea, remaining count, submit button with disabled and loading states, inline success and error feedback, validation (empty, over-length, quota exhausted) and a history list, using only the existing client in game/frontend/src/api/client.ts. Expected result: players contribute without leaving the game, with keyboard and focus handled correctly. Why: the StoryForge redesign requires a polished in-game contribution UX with no Firebase, no database and no Git credentials in the browser.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the gameplay screen, when the Suggest What Happens Next button is activated, then a modal dialog opens without any navigation or URL change
- Given an open modal, when the player submits valid text, then the existing submitContribution client call is used and success or error feedback appears inline
- Given empty text, over-length text or an exhausted quota, when the player tries to submit, then no API call is made and an inline validation message is shown
- Given an open modal, when it opens, closes or Escape is pressed, then focus moves into the dialog, is trapped, and returns to the trigger on close


## Scope
- In scope: ContributionSheet component in game/frontend/src/components
- In scope: App wiring of the trigger button
- In scope: Unit tests with fetch mocked
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: Firebase, database or Git credentials in the browser
- Out of scope: Admin console
- Preserve: submitContribution and listMine contracts in client.ts
- Preserve: 401 session-retry behavior
- Preserve: Existing tests/contribution.test.tsx expectations


## Technical constraints
- React + TypeScript, Radix Dialog (@radix-ui/react-dialog already in package.json)
- Use only the existing client in src/api/client.ts for submit and history


## Definition of done
- All requirements delivered and their Verify units green


## Non-functional requirements
- Keyboard accessible dialog


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Contribution modal is a Radix dialog opened from gameplay with correct focus and keyboard behavior
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet renders a div with role=dialog and no focus management. Desired behavior: Radix Dialog gives focus trapping, Escape to close and focus restore to the trigger, without navigation. Expected result: keyboard users can open, use and dismiss the modal. Why: accessibility and polish requirement.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the gameplay screen, when the trigger button is clicked, then a role=dialog named 'Suggest What Happens Next' is in the document and location is unchanged
- Given an open dialog, when Escape is pressed, then onClose is called and the dialog is removed
- Given the dialog opens, then focus is inside the dialog, and after closing, focus returns to the trigger button


## Scope
- In scope: ContributionSheet Dialog shell
- In scope: App trigger wiring
- Out of scope: Validation and history logic
- Preserve: Props open, onClose, roundId
- Preserve: Heading text and form labels


## Technical constraints
- Use @radix-ui/react-dialog


## Definition of done
- Dialog is Radix-based and keyboard accessible


## Non-functional requirements
- Accessible name and description present


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Submit validates input and quota and shows disabled, loading and inline feedback states
nodes.body:
Context: handleSubmit silently ignores empty text, has no length check, allows sending past quota and has no success message. Desired behavior: client-side validation with inline messages, Send disabled while sending or quota is exhausted, and a visible success message. Expected result: invalid submissions never reach the API. Why: clear feedback and fewer wasted calls.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given empty or whitespace text, when Send is clicked, then a role=alert 'Enter an idea before sending' shows and fetch is not called
- Given text longer than 500 characters, when Send is clicked, then a role=alert mentioning the 500 character limit shows and fetch is not called
- Given remaining is 0, then the textarea and Send are disabled and 'No contributions left' shows
- Given a submit in flight, then Send is disabled and reads 'Sending…'; on success a role=status 'Idea sent' shows; on API error the mapped error shows in role=alert


## Scope
- In scope: Validation, submit states and feedback in ContributionSheet
- In scope: MAX_PROMPT_LEN constant in client.ts
- Out of scope: Backend limit changes
- Preserve: errorMessage mapping for 429 and 409
- Preserve: MAX_PER_PLAYER of 5


## Technical constraints
- MAX_PROMPT_LEN = 500 mirrors MaxPromptLen in backend/internal/contribution/service.go (rune count)


## Definition of done
- Invalid input never calls submitContribution


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Modal shows a contribution history list with loading and error states from the backend client
nodes.body:
Context: history is fetched best-effort and failures are swallowed; entries show only prompt and state. Desired behavior: history list loaded through listMine shows prompts with status, with visible loading, empty and load-error states. Expected result: players see their prior ideas or why none appear. Why: history requirement of the intent.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given listMine resolves with contributions, when the dialog opens, then each prompt appears in the 'Your suggestions' list marked Sent
- Given listMine is pending, then 'Loading suggestions…' shows; given it resolves empty, then 'No suggestions yet' shows
- Given listMine rejects, then role=alert 'Could not load your suggestions' shows and submitting still works


## Scope
- In scope: History states in ContributionSheet
- Out of scope: New backend endpoint for other players' contributions
- Preserve: Merge of in-flight entries with loaded history


## Technical constraints
- Use listMine from client.ts only


## Definition of done
- History states render for each outcome


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.action: Add a new exported constant mirroring backend MaxPromptLen in backend/internal/contribution/service.go.
Add state `const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false)` and `const [sending, setSending] = useState(false)`. Compute `const exhausted = remaining <= 0`. Import MAX_PROMPT_LEN.
steps.expected: Component tracks sending, success and exhausted

steps.action: After preventDefault: return early if exhausted or sending. Compute prompt = text.trim(). If prompt === '' call setError('Enter an idea before sending') and return. If Array.from(prompt).length > MAX_PROMPT_LEN call setError(`Ideas are limited to ${MAX_PROMPT_LEN} characters`) and return. Before the await call setSuccess(false) and setSending(true); on success setSuccess(true); on catch keep existing failed handling; in a finally block setSending(false).
steps.expected: Invalid input sets an alert and never calls submitContribution; valid input sets success after resolve

steps.action:
Set textarea disabled={exhausted || sending}. Set the submit button disabled={exhausted || sending} with text {sending ? 'Sending…' : 'Send'}. Below the form render

No contributions left

when exhausted, and

Idea sent

when success is true.
steps.expected: Send is disabled while sending or exhausted; status and exhausted message render
